So there have been a lot of requests for hoverzoom to work with slimgur, unfortunately that's not possible. Each of the hoverzoom extensions need programming on their end, there is nothing that I can do in order to make their program find my images. The exception to this issue is the Imagus extension (chrome extension here, Firefox extension here). Imagus works with all the same sites as hoverzoom and other similar extensions, the difference is that Imagus also allows you to make custom rules for additional sites.

So to enable it to work with slimgur, open up the options for imagus and select the "sieve" tab, the click the "import rule button" which looks like '↓' then paste the following code into the box: pastebin for code

{"slimgur":{"useimg":1,"link":"^[^/]{4,70}/image/\\w+$","res":"ratio:\\s*\\d+\\.\\d+,\\s*url: ?\"([^\"]+)\n=\"og:title\" content=\"([^\"]+)","img":"^([^/]{4,70}/images/20(?:\\d\\d/){3}.+\\.)(?:th|md)\\.","to":"$1"}}

and then click the "from text" button and then the save button. You may need to restart your browser for it to take effect.
